comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
R14 handicrafts recipe "Making Sapphire Knife", found at Lorenzo's palace in Florence via his maid, Anita. Costs 1,000 Handicrafts points per production and needs the following ingredients.

Goldwork x10
Steel x20
Highest-grade Sapphire x10

Stats:

Handicrafts+1
Wares Trading+2
7k fame to equip

Nice toy for merchants and ware traders, though annoyingly difficult to make from what I hear. Cheers.

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
It's not actually annoying difficult to get that Highest-grade Sapphire or other Highest-grade gems. What is difficult is to produce anything from Anita that requires Highest-grade Platinum or High-grade Platinum because the rarity of Platinum Ore that even harder than actually getting Large Gemstone Nugget. For the example is Platinum Laurel Wreath, not everyone have time to even bother making this.

The +2 Wares Trading still make this thing worth to make though, thanks for the info.
